drone_interaction.vision_modality: High-speed 2D optical edge detection calculating pod elongation curve derivative
drone_interaction.harvest_tool: Vision-guided high-speed micro-bypass shears severing pedicel 5 mm above pod cap (target length: 6.5-9.0 cm)

exhaustive_medicinal_and_bioactive_compo.bioactive_mechanisms: Forms viscoelastic intestinal hydration gel; binds bile acids and slows enzymatic glucose uptake
exhaustive_medicinal_and_bioactive_compo.human_therapeutic_efficacy: Reduces serum LDL cholesterol, blunts postprandial glucose spikes, and protects gastric mucosa
exhaustive_medicinal_and_bioactive_compo.extraction_or_utilization: Liberated into culinary broths or cold aqueous mucilage infusions

exhaustive_medicinal_and_bioactive_compo.bioactive_mechanisms: Competitive alpha-glucosidase inhibition in intestinal brush-border membranes
exhaustive_medicinal_and_bioactive_compo.human_therapeutic_efficacy: Improves insulin sensitivity and reduces vascular oxidative stress
exhaustive_medicinal_and_bioactive_compo.extraction_or_utilization: Retained intact during quick high-heat searing or raw slicing

penalties_and_risks: Strict daily harvest urgency (delay of 24-48 hours causes irreversible xylem lignification into woody inedibility).
Foliage epidermal prickles and trichome dust create mechanical and optical sensor abrasion.
human_culinary_use: Crisp and tender when young. Sliced into stews as a natural thickening agent, blistered whole in cast-iron mess skillets, pickled in cider brine, or dried into prebiotic mucilage flour.
